race.comment: BOLD NOMAD (8) is a Neorealism filly on debut for the Taylor yard. Has trialled up a treat in readiness and appears to have her share of ability. Drawn sticky but gets a key booking in Maloney, who partnered in the most recent trial win. Bright start anticipated. FLARESSENCE (9) brings the strongest race form, having been beaten a nose at Eagle Farm on debut before missing by a neck at Doomben. Drops back from Wednesday racing but could have a race on her hands. POETIC BELLE (12) is another debutante that has shown good signs in her lead-up work. Is drawn cosy on the inside on her home track and can make her presence felt. BOOTS (3) has failed to meet expectations so far but keeps Thompson second-up. Not forgetting.
